title: PRISM: PRIvileged Sibling-guided Multi-Agent Topology Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.20628v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) based on large language models (LLMs) have become a powerful way to address complex problems, and their effectiveness depends critically on the collaboration topology that decides which agents participate and how they communicate. Recent work learns to generate this topology from the task query, fitting the generator to corpora of execution-verified graphs. The post-training method for such generators remains a limitation: a corpus lists the graphs that solved a query but never ranks them, leaving continued supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with no per-query preference to exploit. Without such a preference, the generator drifts toward the topologies the corpus contains most often rather than those that suit each query, so a gain on one task can come at a cost on another. We propose PRISM, which recovers per-query signal from the same corpus by learning with privileged information: a teacher reads, through a zero-init

translated_title: PRISM：基于特权兄弟引导的多智能体拓扑设计
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）已成为解决复杂问题的强大途径，其有效性关键取决于协作拓扑结构，即决定哪些智能体参与以及它们之间如何通信。近期研究致力于从任务查询中学习生成这种拓扑，将生成器拟合到经执行验证的图语料库上。然而，此类生成器的后训练方法仍存在局限：语料库仅列出了解决某个查询的图，却从未对其进行排序，使得持续的有监督微调（SFT）无法利用针对每个查询的偏好信息。缺乏这种偏好时，生成器会漂移向语料库中出现最频繁的拓扑，而非适合每个具体查询的拓扑，导致在一个任务上的收益可能以另一个任务上的损失为代价。我们提出PRISM，通过特权信息学习从同一语料库中恢复针对每个查询的信号：教师通过零初始化……（原文摘要在此处截断，信息不完整）
tldr: PRISM通过特权信息学习从无排序的拓扑语料库中恢复针对每个查询的偏好信号，为大语言模型多智能体系统设计更适配具体任务的协作拓扑，克服了传统监督微调偏向高频拓扑的局限。
